display.purpose: Page-level dashboard, authentication, and results headings only.

headline.purpose: Dominant statements inside feature regions such as the daily edition.

title.purpose: Compact panel, recommendation, and record headings.

body.purpose: Questions, explanations, instructions, supporting copy, and field values.

label.purpose: Uppercase metadata, actions, breadcrumbs, tabs, and field labels.

shadows.name: practice-sheet
shadows.purpose: Minimal ambient lift for the active question sheet on larger screens; removed at 640px.

shadows.name: selected-record
shadows.purpose: Structural selection marker for the current learner's leaderboard row.

motion.name: state-transition
motion.purpose: Color, border, text, and one-pixel transform changes when reduced motion is not requested.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: High-contrast command for the single dominant action in a practice region.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-width: 176px; height: 48px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 10px; padding: 0 19px; border: 1px solid var(--nav); border-radius: 2px; background: var(--nav); color: #fff; font-family: var(--display); font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .07em; text-transform: uppercase; transition: background-color 140ms ease, border-color 140ms ease, transform 140ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary svg { width: 17px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 2; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(.94); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgb(2 78 201 / 24%); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(0); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Ruled companion action that remains subordinate to the main command.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { height: 48px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 10px; padding: 0 19px; border: 1px solid var(--ink); border-radius: 2px; background: transparent; color: var(--ink); font-family: var(--display); font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .07em; text-transform: uppercase; transition: background-color 140ms ease, color 140ms ease; } .ds-btn-secondary svg { width: 17px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 2; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: var(--ink); color: #fff; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgb(2 78 201 / 24%); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-secondary:active { background: var(--nav); }

components.name: Labeled Input
components.description: Persistent archive label and high-contrast answer or account field.
components.css: .ds-field { display: block; color: var(--ink); font-family: var(--display); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .08em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-field input { width: 100%; height: 50px; display: block; margin-top: 7px; padding: 0 14px; border: 1px solid #99958d; border-radius: 2px; background: #fff; color: var(--ink); font-family: var(--body); font-size: 14px; text-transform: none; transition: border-color 140ms ease; } .ds-field input:hover { border-color: var(--ink); } .ds-field input:focus-visible { border-color: var(--blue); outline: 3px solid rgb(2 78 201 / 16%); outline-offset: 0; }

components.name: Edition Card
components.description: Numbered subject record with a functional category edge and compact score.
components.css: .ds-edition-card { position: relative; width: 100%; min-height: 92px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 76px 1fr auto 22px; align-items: center; gap: 14px; padding: 14px 15px 14px 18px; border: 1px solid #8d8981; background: var(--surface); color: var(--ink); text-align: left; transition: background-color 140ms ease, border-color 140ms ease, transform 140ms ease; } .ds-edition-card::before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: -1px auto -1px -1px; width: 5px; background: var(--orange); } .ds-edition-number { display: flex; flex-direction: column; font-family: var(--display); font-size: 36px; font-weight: 700; line-height: .8; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-edition-number small { margin-bottom: 6px; font-size: 9px; letter-spacing: .08em; } .ds-edition-copy { display: flex; flex-direction: column; } .ds-edition-copy strong { font-family: var(--display); font-size: 17px; letter-spacing: .04em; } .ds-edition-copy small { margin-top: 4px; color: var(--muted); font-family: var(--body); font-size: 10px; } .ds-edition-card > b { font-family: var(--display); font-size: 17px; } .ds-edition-card svg { width: 17px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 2; } .ds-edition-card:hover { border-color: var(--ink); background: #fff; transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-edition-card:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgb(2 78 201 / 24%); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-edition-card:active { transform: translateY(0); }

components.name: Daily Ledger
components.description: Adjacent progress record with fixed question segments and a tabular count.
components.css: .ds-daily-ledger { min-height: 220px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; padding: 24px 20px; border: 1px solid var(--ink); background: var(--surface); color: var(--ink); } .ds-daily-ledger > span, .ds-daily-ledger > b { font-family: var(--display); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .08em; } .ds-daily-ledger > strong { margin-top: 16px; font-family: var(--display); font-size: 52px; line-height: .9; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-daily-ledger > b { margin-top: 7px; font-size: 14px; } .ds-daily-ledger > div { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(10, 1fr); gap: 5px; margin: 24px 0; } .ds-daily-ledger i { aspect-ratio: 1; border: 1px solid #77746e; } .ds-daily-ledger i:nth-child(-n+4) { border-color: var(--blue); background: var(--blue); } .ds-daily-ledger > small { margin-top: auto; padding-top: 12px; border-top: 1px solid var(--rule); color: var(--muted); font-family: var(--body); font-size: 11px; }

components.name: Desktop Navigation
components.description: Dark authenticated rail with an indexed active destination.
components.html: QUIZFORGE
components.css: .ds-nav { width: 238px; min-height: 360px; display: grid; align-content: start; padding: 34px 24px; background: var(--nav); color: #fff; } .ds-nav > strong { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 9px; margin-bottom: 48px; font-family: var(--display); font-size: 29px; font-weight: 800; } .ds-nav > strong i { width: 16px; height: 16px; background: var(--orange); } .ds-nav button { position: relative; height: 48px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 13px; padding: 0 12px; border: 0; background: transparent; color: #a9a8a3; font-family: var(--display); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .08em; text-align: left; transition: color 140ms ease; } .ds-nav button::before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 9px auto 9px -24px; width: 4px; } .ds-nav button.ds-active::before { background: var(--blue); } .ds-nav button:hover, .ds-nav button.ds-active { color: #fff; } .ds-nav button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #fff; outline-offset: -2px; } .ds-nav svg { width: 19px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 2; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; }

components.name: Archive Tabs
components.description: Ruled period switcher with a blue indexed selection state.
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: flex; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--ink); } .ds-tabs button { min-height: 44px; padding: 0 20px; border: 0; border-bottom: 3px solid transparent; background: transparent; color: var(--muted); font-family: var(--display); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .06em; } .ds-tabs button[aria-selected='true'] { border-color: var(--blue); color: var(--ink); } .ds-tabs button:hover { color: var(--ink); } .ds-tabs button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgb(2 78 201 / 20%); outline-offset: -3px; } .ds-tabs button:active { background: #e7eef9; }

components.name: Correct Feedback
components.description: Explicit correct-answer state with icon, text label, and bordered explanation.
components.html:
CORRECT / +10 XP

Nice recall.

WHY IT MATTERS

The explanation records the useful connection in clear, readable body text.
components.css: .ds-feedback { color: var(--ink); } .ds-feedback header { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 13px; } .ds-feedback header > span { width: 44px; height: 44px; display: grid; place-items: center; border: 1px solid var(--forest); color: var(--forest); } .ds-feedback svg { width: 22px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 2; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; } .ds-feedback small, .ds-feedback strong { color: var(--forest); font-family: var(--display); font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .1em; } .ds-feedback h3 { margin: 3px 0 0; font-family: var(--display); font-size: 25px; } .ds-feedback > div { margin-top: 24px; padding: 18px 20px; border: 1px solid #bfd0c6; border-top: 3px solid var(--forest); background: #e8eee9; } .ds-feedback > div strong { color: var(--ink); } .ds-feedback p { margin: 6px 0 0; color: #4f514e; font-family: var(--body); font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.7; }

narrative.overview:
QuizForge treats daily study as a trusted, accumulating record. The visual world combines the clarity of a labeled collection, the confidence of a tournament program, and the utility of a serious study tool. Numbered editions, precise rules, compact metadata, and tabular measures make progress feel recorded rather than merely decorated.

The archive reference stays flat and digital. Warm paper grounds the experience; an ink-black rail gives authenticated screens a stable spine; archive orange identifies the featured daily set; index blue marks selection, progress, and links. Warmth comes through plainspoken copy, generous breathing room, and controlled color rather than illustration or soft effects.
keyCharacteristics: Flat, warm work surfaces framed by dark navigation and precise rules.
Condensed, uppercase metadata paired with calm, highly legible body copy.
Numbered subject editions and segmented progress as recurring identity devices.
One dominant practice action per screen, with supporting records kept compact.
Functional color, explicit state feedback, and restrained motion.

rules.name: The Functional Ink Rule
rules.body: Orange announces the featured practice object; blue marks navigation, selection, and progress. Do not swap their jobs for variety.

rules.name: The Solid Field Rule
rules.body: Large color fields are solid. Gradients, glows, translucent blobs, and decorative color haze do not belong in this system.

rules.name: The Two-Voice Rule
rules.body: Barlow Condensed identifies and organizes; Inter explains and supports. Do not set long-form reading text in the condensed face.

rules.name: The Earned Scale Rule
rules.body: Hero-scale type belongs to page-level headings. Panels and repeated records remain compact enough to scan.

rules.name: The One Scan Rule
rules.body: The primary action, current record, and next practice path must remain legible in one scan at every breakpoint.

rules.name: The Flat-by-Default Rule
rules.body: No dashboard section receives a shadow merely to become a card. Use rules, alignment, or a semantic color field first.

rules.name: The Shape Means Role Rule
rules.body: Rectangles hold work and records; circles identify people. Do not turn text actions, tabs, filters, or labels into pills.

dos: Do use numbering, short uppercase labels, strong rules, and tabular metrics to make practice feel indexed and trustworthy.
Do keep one dominant task per screen and align supporting information into compact records.
Do reserve orange for featured practice and blue for selection, navigation, focus, and progress.
Do preserve visible focus, explicit labels, non-color feedback, stable touch targets, responsive wrapping, and reduced-motion behavior.
Do let mobile reorganize the hierarchy rather than merely shrink desktop tracks.
donts: Don't literalize the archive with cardboard texture, perspective, three-dimensional boxes, or ornamental nostalgia.
Don't introduce gradients, glows, translucent blobs, ambient motion, or decorative image fields.
Don't float page sections as decorative cards or nest cards inside cards.
Don't soften controls into pills or apply large radii to repeated records.
Don't invent photography, illustration, testimonials, or proof assets that the product does not have.
